end.summary: Practised identifying top, front and side views of solids.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing and matching views using the shapes of cones, cylinders, cubes and caps. They explained that a cone looks triangular from the side and a cylinder looks rectangular from the side, and used object features such as a point, flat base and straight sides. Some answers were mixed up during the final check and were not corrected afterward. At home, ask Reyansh to sketch or name the top and side views of one household object at a time.
